rows.definition: The turn-count multiplier in cmd/dispatchworker/guard.go that converts the per-turn model window ceiling into the CUMULATIVE --context-budget-tokens allowance a dispatch claude worker launches with: budget = max(hardCap - outputReserve, baseline) x claudeGuardTurnsPerEpoch. Set to 12 so the 3-equivalent-restart reaper (3 x 12 = 36 turns) stays behind the ~30-turn wall-clock runway, letting the graceful --max-duration drain win.
rows.distinction: A COUNT OF TURNS scaling a cumulative allowance - NOT a per-turn window size and NOT a compaction shed line. It replaced claudeGuardBirthHeadroomFactor, which applied a factor to a per-turn quantity and then clamped the result by the window ceiling, funding only two turns and killing 120/120 workers with BUDGET_CONTEXT_EXHAUSTED.

rows.definition: The cmd/dispatchworker/guard.go builder that produces the OpenCode-native 96K shed-line configuration overlay for a worker command, or nil when the provider's real limits are unknown so the launch fails OPEN. Mirrors dispatch_worker.opencode_compaction_overlay on the python side.
rows.distinction: A CONFIG DOCUMENT FRAGMENT that tells a third-party harness when to compact - NOT fak's own CompactionBudget threshold and NOT the compaction act itself; it allocates nothing and rewrites no history.

rows.definition: The cmd/dispatchworker/guard.go merge that folds the opencode compaction overlay into an existing OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT document while preserving operator-supplied keys, returning the existing document unchanged when there is no overlay to apply.
rows.distinction: A MERGE over an operator-supplied env document - NOT the overlay it merges (opencodeCompactionOverlay) and NOT the guard policy or its floor. The Go launcher points opencode at guard via --base-url, so unlike the python half this does not also rewrite the provider baseURL.
